name: Contextual Close-up Volume Rendering Pipeline
aliases: Multi-resolution B-spline volume rendering with gradient quantization
definition: A visualization system for real-time high-quality rendering of clinical volumetric data that provides contextual close-up views of Regions of Interest (ROI) while preserving overall context, using decimation for interactivity, B-spline subdivision for super-resolution, fast gradient quantization for feature extraction, and GPU fragment shaders for rendering.
